dimensions.name: project

dimensions.name: user

dimensions.name: hostname
dimensions.description: Device hostname reported by the Go hooks (gram.hook.hostname).

dimensions.name: department
dimensions.description: Directory department of the user.

dimensions.name: division
dimensions.description: Directory division of the user.

dimensions.name: job_title
dimensions.description: Directory job title of the user.

dimensions.name: employee_type
dimensions.description: Directory employee type of the user.

dimensions.name: cost_center
dimensions.description: Directory cost center of the user.

dimensions.name: model
dimensions.description: Effective model of the response. Source-aware: Claude api_request rows carry it on attributes.model / gen_ai.request.model, everyone else on gen_ai.response.model.

dimensions.name: surface
dimensions.description: Consuming agent surface (claude-code, cursor, codex, cowork, ...).

dimensions.name: account_type
dimensions.description: AI account classification: team | personal | '' (unclassified).

dimensions.name: provider
dimensions.description: AI provider for the account: anthropic | openai | cursor | ''.

dimensions.name: billing_mode
dimensions.description: How the account is billed: metered (real spend) | flat_rate (estimate) | unknown | ''.

dimensions.name: query_source
dimensions.description: Claude attribution: where the query originated. Empty means the attribute does not apply to the row.

dimensions.description: Claude attribution: skill active for the turn.

dimensions.name: mcp_server
dimensions.description: Claude attribution: MCP server used by the turn.

dimensions.name: mcp_tool
dimensions.description: Claude attribution: MCP tool used by the turn.

dimensions.name: role
dimensions.description: Directory roles of the user (multi-valued).

dimensions.name: group
dimensions.description: Directory groups of the user (multi-valued).

dimensions.name: session
dimensions.description: The chat/session id: one agent conversation.

dimensions.name: turn
dimensions.description: The turn identity within a session: Claude prompt.id, Codex row-id fallback, generic gen_ai.response.id.

models.name: usage
models.description: one provider response observed from an agent surface at response time

measures.name: total_work_units
measures.description: work units delivered by scored sessions (chat_analysis score rows)

measures.name: scored_cost
measures.description: cost in USD of the sessions that carry a work-units score

measures.name: scored_tokens
measures.description: tokens of the sessions that carry a work-units score

caveats: This table conflates locally-observed and provider-settled usage rows: the Cursor hook and the Admin-API poller both stamp cursor:usage:metrics rows and the MV merges them, so a workspace observed through both double-counts here. Declared, not fixed (DNO follow-up); the provider_reports model serves the settled complement and the MV fix is a separate change.

tool_calls carries a transitional fallback (expand-contract): rows written before the unique_tool_calls column existed hold only the default empty state, so uniqExactIfMerge resolves to 0 on them even when total_tool_calls counted calls. The if() falls back to the legacy row count for such groups until the backfiller rebuilds history; groups mixing pre- and post-migration buckets undercount (accepted as transitional).

Queries grouping or filtering on identity dimensions fall through to the raw telemetry_logs binding.
